phrases.latin: Hīc sumus nōs: haec est Bulgaria
phrases.english: Here we are: this is Bulgaria

phrases.latin: Haec tabula mōnstrat ubi thēsaurus dēfossus sit.
phrases.english: This map shows where the treasure is buried.

phrases.latin: Ubi crux picta est, ibi fodiēmus.
phrases.english: We’ll dig where the cross is drawn.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 30, 205, 343.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
